summary: Verified PageHeader ring fix on /programmering. Mobile (390px): all 5 rings render with responsive widths 214.5/351/507/663/819px (min(desk px, vw)), all intersect header viewport (visibleCount=5, expected>=3), mixBlendMode=normal, borderColor=rgba(255,255,255,0.38), animation=blendRingFlash active, no horizontal overflow (docW=390). Desktop (1920px): rings capped at 500/800/1100/1400/1700px, mixBlendMode=soft-light, animation active, no overflow. Homepage mobile regression: hero rings still 600/900/1200px with mixBlend=normal and border rgba(255,255,255,0.38) — previous fix intact. All assertions in review request pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PageHeader ring responsive sizing verified on /programmering. Mobile shows 5 rings (214/351/507/663/819px = 55/90/130/170/210vw at 390px viewport). Desktop caps at 500/800/1100/1400/1700px. Homepage hero rings on mobile remain at fixed larger sizes with mixBlendMode=normal (previous iteration fix).
rca of the issue: Previous fixed px sizes (500/800/1100/1400/1700) exceeded mobile viewport (390px), so only the smallest ring was partially visible. Fix uses min(desk px, vw) so vw wins on mobile, px cap wins on desktop — verified with computed styles.
